title: Local-frame equality and projection
summary: Proves Wasm.Locals equality from its three fields, preserves combined getters across operand-stack replacement, and converts combined getters to internal-list facts.
premises: For frame equality, equality of parameter, internal-local, and operand-stack lists
For operand-stack replacement, a frame and replacement value stack
For internal projection, the parameter count, a valid internal-local index, and a combined Locals.get equation
result: The proof obtains exact frame equality, unchanged local projections after replacing the operand stack, or the corresponding internal-list value.
